menus.name: JL Studio tasting experience
menus.note: Lunch (Saturday and Sunday) or dinner (Wednesday to Sunday); drinks, water and 10% service extra

bookingOpens: Online on inline only; bookings aren't taken by phone, email or social media. Tables can be booked up to 30 days ahead, for parties of one to four. A deposit of NT$3,000 per person is taken by Visa, Mastercard or JCB.
cancellation: The deposit is refunded in full for cancellations more than 48 hours ahead. Within 48 hours it isn't refunded, though the booking may be moved once; within 24 hours it is forfeited.
waitlist: When a time is full, the inline booking page offers a waitlist.
groups: Parties of five or more, events and buyouts are arranged by email to info@jlstudiotw.com. The second floor seats up to 28 and the third floor up to 30 for private dining.
dressCode: Smart elegant. Men are asked to wear long trousers and closed shoes; no sportswear, shorts, beachwear, sandals or slippers.
children: Children must be 12 or older, and there is no children's menu.
byob: Corkage is NT$1,000 a bottle for wine, Champagne or sake and NT$1,500 for spirits (750ml or less); cakeage NT$500.
